Card Q&A.a: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.
Card Q&A.q: How do I activate this card’s inherited effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. The card text reads, “you may,” so you can choose to only place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits under this Tamer without digivolving.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits under this Tamer from my trash, and then choose not to digivolve into [EmperorGreymon]?
If I only have 4 cards in my trash with [Hybrid] in their traits, can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 4 cards from my trash under this Tamer without digivolving?

Card Q&A.a: No. With this Tamer's [Main] effect, you cannot digivolve into any other Digimon than [EmperorGreymon].
Card Q&A.q: When I activate this Tamer's [Main] effect and do not digivolve into [EmperorGreymon], can I instead digivolve into some other level 6 Digimon, like [AncientGreymon]?

Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
